archived.role: Actual Arizona in-ground Erioneuron pilosum tuft with leaf clusters emerging from soil and intact stalks bearing several pale woolly flowering heads. ROOTS still belowground.
Close natural field view of E. pilosum's distinctive narrow inward-folded gray-green basal blades edged with pale margins above brown leaf litter. Collars/ligules not opened.

High-detail real E. pilosum compact head with pointed overlapping pale spikelet parts and a profusion of thin white silk-like hairs beside photographer's fingers. No dissection to individually assign glumes or lemmas.
